# 1 Clement Chapter 22 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal Equivalence)

**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Codex Alexandrinus, 1 Clement 22 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/1CL_022_page_001.jpg

---

## Chapter 22

**22:1** Now faith in Christ confirms all these things; for he himself through the Holy Spirit calls to us thus: "Come, children, hear me; I will teach you the fear of the Lord."

**22:2** "Who is the man who desires life, who loves to see good days?

**22:3** Keep your tongue from evil and your lips from speaking deceit.

**22:4** Turn aside from evil and do good; seek peace and pursue it.

**22:5** The eyes of the Lord are upon the righteous, and his ears are open to their supplication.

**22:6** But the face of the Lord is set against those who do evil, to cut off the remembrance of them from the earth." [Ps 34:11-16 LXX]

**22:7** And again: "The righteous man cried out, and the Lord heard him and delivered him from all his afflictions." [Ps 34:17 LXX]

**22:8** "Many are the afflictions of the righteous, but from them all the Lord will deliver him." [Ps 34:19 LXX]

**22:9** "Many are the troubles of the sinner, but mercy shall encircle him who hopes in the Lord." [Ps 32:10 LXX]

---

*LOGOS formal equivalence.*
